Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

repeat verb

say or do again

also say again, say that again, repeat after me, do again, repetition, repeat the passage, repeat what you just said

classical

Cic. Att. 14.14.1: Iterādum eadem ista mihi.
Liv. 1.45.2 (Lewis & Short): saepe iterandō eadem

iterō, iterāre, iterāvī, iterātum

verb, first conjugation, transitive

say or do a second time, repeat

From iterum, “a second time”: to say the same words again, or do a thing again (pugnam iterāre, Liv. 6.32). In farming it is to plough a second time (Lewis & Short).

Other words

  • repetō, repetere, repetīvī, repetītum — go over again, repeat; resume

    verb, third conjugation, transitive · also used · classical · Traupman 34: repete quid modo dīxerīs, repeat what you just said; Cic. Fin. 5.51 (Lewis & Short): praetermissa repetimus; Traupman 31; Traupman 34: repeat the passage, repete (repetite) locum

    To go back over what was said or begun, so also to resume; Traupman’s classroom word. Its first senses are to attack again and to go back for, fetch, or claim back (rēs repetere); Lewis & Short.

  • dīcō iterum (rūrsus) — say again

    phrase · also used · classical

    The plain way: Dīc iterum, say it again. Traupman 34 has eīsdem verbīs mihi redde for “repeat after me”.

  • repetītiō, repetītiōnis f. — repetition

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Quint. 9.1.24 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 31

  • eīsdem verbīs reddere — repeat word for word

    reddō with the ablative eīsdem verbīs · also used · classical · Cic. Brut. 301: ut quae sēcum commentātus esset, ea sine scrīptō verbīs eīsdem redderet (Lewis & Short s.v. reddō); Traupman 34: repeat after me, eīsdem verbīs mihi redde (reddite)

    Reddere is to give back what one has heard or learned, so “repeat after me” is eīsdem verbīs mihi redde, “give it back to me in the same words”.

Examples

  • Iterādum eadem ista mihi.

    Say that to me again!Cic. Att. 14.14.1

  • repete quid modo dīxerīs

    repeat what you just saidTraupman 34

  • Eīsdem verbīs mihi redde (reddite).

    Repeat after me.Traupman 34

  • Repete (repetite) locum.

    Repeat the passage.Traupman 34

See also again, chant, every so often, say.
